purposes.yaw_degrees: The inspected raw boar faces -Y. Rotate to Blender +Y front / Godot -Z front without changing anatomy.
purposes.height_metres: Review scale from ground to tallest bristle; not a new enemy body or gameplay scale.
purposes.scar_paths: Authored side-projected paths in normalized body Y/Z metres. Break across a few shield plates into tough hide; preserve face, joints and most coat.
purposes.half_width_metres: Width of the dark scar mouth, separate from its narrow luminous core.
purposes.core_half_width_metres: Keep light inside the fracture; large enough to read at ordinary encounter distance.
purposes.recess_metres: Shallow physical incision retains solid backing and reads with emission disabled.
purposes.projection_step_metres: Resolve the surface of individual shield plates instead of floating a tube above them.
purposes.mask_size: Shared linear RGBA mask: core, damaged host, branch travel, opaque reserved channel; follows existing UVs through skinning.
purposes.peak_emission: Local Red core brightness at pulse peak; does not add a light or change scene exposure.
purposes.minimum_light: Keep a faint interior between passing crests.
purposes.period_seconds: Smooth, visible four-second current; compared with a 2.5-second option.
purposes.crest_width: Fraction of branch travel illuminated by the moving crest.
purposes.colour: Ember-associated art colour; adds no Red gameplay transformation or damage.
